Found the 4 violations the fixture's own comments flag, plus 6 additional violations/gaps not called out in those comments, for 10 total findings. ## Findings by category ### Semantic HTML / ARIA **1. `

` with only an `onclick` handler and no `tabindex`/keydown handler cannot be reached or activated from a keyboard at all. - Also: **4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (Level A)** — no `role="button"`, so assistive technology exposes it as plain static text, not an interactive control. - (The fixture's own comment cites 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured — that SC concerns a visible focus indicator being hidden by other content; it doesn't apply since the element can't be focused at all. Correct citations are 2.1.1 and 4.1.2, with **2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)** as a downstream consequence.) - Severity: **Critical/Blocker** — the form's sole submit control; no non-mouse user can complete the task. - Fix: replace with ``. **2. `` — line 28-30** - WCAG 2.2: **4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (Level A)** — `aria-label=""` is an explicit empty string that overrides the "×" text content, leaving the button with **no accessible name at all** (worse than omitting `aria-label`). - Severity: **Critical**. - Fix: `aria-label="Close"` (or whatever it actually dismisses) — remove the empty-string override. ### Color contrast / status indication **3. `Invalid format` — line 17** - WCAG 2.2: **1.4.1 Use of Color (Level A)** — color is the only channel conveying "this is an error"; no icon/bold/prefix. - Secondary: **1.3.1 Info and Relationships (Level A)** — no `id`, never referenced via `aria-describedby` on the email input, so it's not programmatically associated. - Secondary: **3.3.1 Error Identification (Level A)** — "Invalid format" doesn't say what's invalid or where. - Severity: **Serious** (1.4.1, 1.3.1), **Moderate** (3.3.1). - Fix: `⚠ Error: enter a valid email address (e.g. name@example.com)` + `aria-describedby="email-error" aria-invalid="true"` on the input. - *(Note: no separate 1.4.3 contrast failure — red on default white is well above 4.5:1; the defect is the missing non-color channel and the missing programmatic link.)* ### Forms and labels **4. `` — line 13** - WCAG 2.2: **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (Level A)** — no persistent `
